title: 列車定位與里程融合~Train-position and odometry fusion
focus: 多感測定位的誤差相關性與完整性~Error correlation and integrity in multisensor train localization
summary: 本課聚焦多感測定位的誤差相關性與完整性。從輪徑比例與里程建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把定位不確定度合成與融合感測時基漂移連成可驗證的介面，最後以失訊與錯圖案例整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。~This course studies error correlation and integrity in multisensor train localization. Start with wheel-scale error and odometry to define physical or information boundaries, connect combining localization uncertainty with clock drift in sensor fusion as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through signal-loss and map-error cases. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
history: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：2002 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法早期版發布。；2023 年歐盟列控技術規則二零二三號一六九五發布。；2025 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法第一分冊發布。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對多感測定位的誤差相關性與完整性而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用局部通過速度觀測及定位處理管線連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。~The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 2002: An early railway RAMS specification was published. 2023: European Commission Regulation twenty-twenty-three slash sixteen-ninety-five was adopted. 2025: A new first part of railway RAMS was published. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For error correlation and integrity in multisensor train localization, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through local passage-speed observations and localization processing pipeline. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.
example: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究輪徑比例與里程。原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=1500 m；比例誤差 scale=0.004 1；固定偏差 bias=0.2 m。公式 y=distance*scale+bias，代入得 y=6.2 m。邊界：固定比例誤差與固定偏移，未包含時變輪滑或輪徑磨耗歷程。敏感度只改 distance=1500 至 1650 m，輸出變為 6.8 m；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究局部通過速度觀測：原創假想教學輸入：感測點間距 spacing=0.3 m；通過時間差 dt=0.015 s。公式 y=spacing/dt，代入得 y=20 m/s。邊界：同一輪對等速通過且事件配對正確，忽略感測區域寬度。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元以長短兩段已知路程分離比例誤差與固定偏移，避免單點校正掩蓋長距離漂移。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。~Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate wheel-scale error and odometry. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: travelled distance distance=1500 m; scale error scale=0.004 1; fixed offset bias=0.2 m. Formula y=distance*scale+bias gives y=6.2 m. Boundary: Constant scale error plus fixed offset; variable slip and wheel-wear history are not modelled. For sensitivity, change only distance=1500 to 1650 m; the output becomes 6.8 m. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate local passage-speed observations: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensor separation spacing=0.3 m; passage time difference dt=0.015 s. Formula y=spacing/dt gives y=20 m/s. Boundary: One wheelset moving at constant speed with correct event pairing; sensing-zone width is neglected. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Use short and long known distances to separate scale error from fixed offset, preventing a single calibration point from concealing long-distance drift. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.

units.anchor: 輪徑比例與里程~Wheel-scale error and odometry
units.title: 輪徑比例與里程~Wheel-scale error and odometry
units.mechanism: 本單元以長短兩段已知路程分離比例誤差與固定偏移，避免單點校正掩蓋長距離漂移。輪徑與脈衝換算比例的誤差會隨行走距離累積，固定零點偏差則不隨距離放大。輪滑與空轉使輪周距離不等於地面位移；定期地標校正能約束累積誤差，但地標本身的位置與辨識可信度仍須驗證。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定比例誤差與固定偏移，未包含時變輪滑或輪徑磨耗歷程。~Use short and long known distances to separate scale error from fixed offset, preventing a single calibration point from concealing long-distance drift. Wheel diameter and pulse-scale error accumulate with distance, whereas a fixed zero offset does not grow. Slip makes wheel travel differ from ground displacement. Landmark updates can constrain drift, but the landmark position and identification credibility still require verification. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant scale error plus fixed offset; variable slip and wheel-wear history are not modelled.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=1500 m；比例誤差 scale=0.004 1；固定偏差 bias=0.2 m。公式 y=distance*scale+bias，代入得 y=6.2 m。邊界：固定比例誤差與固定偏移，未包含時變輪滑或輪徑磨耗歷程。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: travelled distance distance=1500 m; scale error scale=0.004 1; fixed offset bias=0.2 m. Formula y=distance*scale+bias gives y=6.2 m. Boundary: Constant scale error plus fixed offset; variable slip and wheel-wear history are not modelled.
units.verify: 在多個已知距離區段繪製殘差對距離，利用斜率與截距分別估計比例及零點。以「輪徑比例與里程」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Plot residual against several known travel distances and use slope and intercept to separate scale and zero-offset effects. For wheel-scale error and odometry, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 一次短距離校正可能掩蓋比例誤差，輪滑事件則在殘差曲線留下突跳而非固定斜率。回到「輪徑比例與里程」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~A short calibration run can hide scale error; slip events cause residual jumps rather than a constant slope. Trace the input chain for wheel-scale error and odometry. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 短距離校正準確就能保證長距離里程也完全準確~Accurate short-distance calibration guarantees perfectly accurate long-distance odometry.
units.practice: 只把行走距離 distance 從 1500 改成 1650 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 6.2 變為 6.8 m。先說明「輪徑比例與里程」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only travelled distance distance from 1500 to 1650 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 6.2 to 6.8 m. Explain the causal direction for wheel-scale error and odometry, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 局部通過速度觀測~Local passage-speed observations
units.title: 局部通過速度觀測~Local passage-speed observations
units.mechanism: 本單元以雙感測點估計局部速度，討論事件配對錯誤如何在里程積分中變成位置跳變。兩個相鄰感測點的事件先後順序可提供方向，間距除以時間差可估局部速度。時間解析度與輪緣幾何都影響結果；接近停車或往返擺動時，事件配對比公式本身更容易出錯。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：同一輪對等速通過且事件配對正確，忽略感測區域寬度。~Estimate local speed with paired sensing points and examine how event-pairing errors become position jumps when integrated into odometry. Event ordering across two nearby sensors provides direction, while separation divided by transit time estimates local speed. Timing resolution and wheel geometry affect the estimate. Near standstill or during oscillatory movement, pairing the correct events is often harder than evaluating the equation. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: One wheelset moving at constant speed with correct event pairing; sensing-zone width is neglected.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：感測點間距 spacing=0.3 m；通過時間差 dt=0.015 s。公式 y=spacing/dt，代入得 y=20 m/s。邊界：同一輪對等速通過且事件配對正確，忽略感測區域寬度。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensor separation spacing=0.3 m; passage time difference dt=0.015 s. Formula y=spacing/dt gives y=20 m/s. Boundary: One wheelset moving at constant speed with correct event pairing; sensing-zone width is neglected.
units.verify: 使用獨立位置尺與時間基準核對事件配對，包含低速、停止與反向的離線測試。以「局部通過速度觀測」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Check event pairing against an independent ruler and clock, including low-speed, stopped and reversed offline tests. For local passage-speed observations, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 將不同輪對的脈衝配成一對會產生不合理速度，反向回滾也會破壞單純遞增事件假設。回到「局部通過速度觀測」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Pairing pulses from different wheelsets produces implausible speed; rollback violates assumptions of monotonically ordered events. Trace the input chain for local passage-speed observations. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 感測點越近就能在所有速度下得到越精準的速度~Closer sensors always give more accurate speed at every operating speed.
units.practice: 只把通過時間差 dt 從 0.015 改成 0.0165 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 20 變為 18.1818 m/s。先說明「局部通過速度觀測」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only passage time difference dt from 0.015 to 0.0165 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 20 to 18.1818 m/s. Explain the causal direction for local passage-speed observations, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 獨立觀測加權融合~Weighted fusion of independent observations
units.title: 獨立觀測加權融合~Weighted fusion of independent observations
units.mechanism: 本單元比較輪速與外部定位的權重，只有在獨立無偏假設有證據時才採用倒變異數加權。獨立無偏觀測可依變異數倒數加權，較小不確定度取得較大權重。融合不會自動修正共同偏差或地圖錯誤；如果兩個感測器實際共享同一來源，當成獨立資料就會過度自信，並把錯誤估計包裝成精準結果。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：兩個獨立高斯無偏位置觀測，不含跨時間濾波與完整性保證。~Compare weights for wheel-based and external position observations, using inverse-variance fusion only when independence and lack of bias are justified. Independent unbiased observations can be weighted by inverse variance, giving more weight to lower uncertainty. Fusion does not automatically remove common bias or map errors. Treating two sensors that share a source as independent creates false confidence and can make an incorrect estimate appear precise. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Two independent Gaussian unbiased position observations, without temporal filtering or integrity assurance.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：觀測一位置 x1=100 m；觀測二位置 x2=104 m；觀測一標準差 s1=2 m；觀測二標準差 s2=4 m。公式 y=(x1/s1**2+x2/s2**2)/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2)，代入得 y=100.8 m。邊界：兩個獨立高斯無偏位置觀測，不含跨時間濾波與完整性保證。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first observed position x1=100 m; second observed position x2=104 m; first standard deviation s1=2 m; second standard deviation s2=4 m. Formula y=(x1/s1**2+x2/s2**2)/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2) gives y=100.8 m. Boundary: Two independent Gaussian unbiased position observations, without temporal filtering or integrity assurance.
units.verify: 以保留的獨立真值資料檢查殘差平均與分布，另測共同偏移時是否仍能被辨識。以「獨立觀測加權融合」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Use held-out independent truth to examine residual mean and spread, then test whether a shared offset remains detectable. For weighted fusion of independent observations, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 共同地圖誤差可讓兩感測器互相同意卻都錯，將相關性忽略會縮小不合理的信賴區間。回到「獨立觀測加權融合」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~A common map error can make both sensors agree while both are wrong; ignored correlation yields unrealistically narrow confidence intervals. Trace the input chain for weighted fusion of independent observations. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 兩個感測器讀值一致就能保證融合位置正確~Agreement between two sensors guarantees a correct fused position.
units.practice: 只把觀測二標準差 s2 從 4 改成 4.4 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 100.8 變為 100.685 m。先說明「獨立觀測加權融合」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only second standard deviation s2 from 4 to 4.4 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 100.8 to 100.685 m. Explain the causal direction for weighted fusion of independent observations, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 定位不確定度合成~Combining localization uncertainty
units.title: 定位不確定度合成~Combining localization uncertainty
units.mechanism: 本單元區分隨機標準差、最大界限與共同偏差，避免以平方和開根號縮小所有誤差。獨立零均值誤差的變異數可以相加，因此標準差以平方和開根號合成。這個做法不適合直接合併最大容差或共同偏差；一旦共享基準造成相關性，協方差項就必須回到計算中，不能繼續假裝量測彼此獨立。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。~Distinguish random standard deviation, maximum bounds and common bias rather than reducing every error through root-sum-square combination. Variances of independent zero-mean errors add, giving a root-sum-square standard deviation. This is not a way to combine maximum tolerances or common bias. When a shared datum creates correlation, covariance terms belong in the calculation rather than assuming continued independence. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：獨立誤差一標準差 s1=3 mm；獨立誤差二標準差 s2=4 mm。公式 y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2)，代入得 y=5 mm。邊界：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first independent standard deviation s1=3 mm; second independent standard deviation s2=4 mm. Formula y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2) gives y=5 mm. Boundary: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound.
units.verify: 以重複量測估計標準差與相關係數，將固定偏差另列，再核對合成殘差。以「定位不確定度合成」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Estimate standard deviations and correlation from repeated observations, separate fixed bias, and compare combined residuals. For combining localization uncertainty, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 共同基準誤差會使所有讀值同向偏移，重複次數增加也無法把這種偏差平均掉。回到「定位不確定度合成」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~A common datum error shifts readings together, and additional repetition cannot average away that shared bias. Trace the input chain for combining localization uncertainty. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號~Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation.
units.practice: 只把獨立誤差一標準差 s1 從 3 改成 3.3 mm（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 5 變為 5.18556 mm。先說明「定位不確定度合成」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only first independent standard deviation s1 from 3 to 3.3 mm (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 5 to 5.18556 mm. Explain the causal direction for combining localization uncertainty, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 延遲定位外推~Extrapolating delayed positions
units.title: 延遲定位外推~Extrapolating delayed positions
units.mechanism: 本單元保留量測原始時間並估算資料變舊期間的前進距離，檢查高速時的誤差放大。位置資料的數值誤差與資料變舊造成的位移應分開處理。即使感測器本身準確，封包等待與處理延遲仍會擴大當前位置的不確定範圍；接收時間不能取代量測時間，否則不同子系統可能各自認為資料是新的。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。~Preserve the original measurement time and estimate travel while the observation ages, examining error growth at higher speed. Position measurement error and displacement accumulated while data ages are separate contributions. Even an accurate sensor can yield an uncertain current location after queuing and processing delays. Reception time cannot substitute for measurement time because subsystems could then each mistakenly regard stale information as new. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant speed and a conservative sum of bounded errors, not root-sum-square combination of random errors.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：列車速度 v=18 m/s；資料年齡 t=0.25 s；定位誤差界 e=0.6 m。公式 y=v*t+e，代入得 y=5.1 m。邊界：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train speed v=18 m/s; data age t=0.25 s; position error bound e=0.6 m. Formula y=v*t+e gives y=5.1 m. Boundary: Constant speed and a conservative sum of bounded errors, not root-sum-square combination of random errors.
units.verify: 保留量測、傳送及接收三個時間戳，以延遲注入重播檢查界限是否包住真值。以「延遲定位外推」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Preserve measurement, transmit and receive timestamps; replay injected delays and verify that the resulting bound encloses the reference position. For extrapolating delayed positions, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 時鐘偏移會偽裝成網路延遲，重設時間戳又可能隱藏陳舊資料，需用獨立時間基準辨認。回到「延遲定位外推」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Clock offset can imitate network delay, while timestamp replacement can conceal stale data; an independent time reference distinguishes them. Trace the input chain for extrapolating delayed positions. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 封包剛收到就代表其中位置一定是現在的位置~A newly received packet always contains the present position.
units.practice: 只把資料年齡 t 從 0.25 改成 0.275 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 5.1 變為 5.55 m。先說明「延遲定位外推」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only data age t from 0.25 to 0.275 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 5.1 to 5.55 m. Explain the causal direction for extrapolating delayed positions, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 速度取樣與空間間距~Speed sampling and spatial intervals
units.title: 速度取樣與空間間距~Speed sampling and spatial intervals
units.mechanism: 本單元將固定時間取樣轉為里程間隔，辨認高速通過短地標時可能漏失的事件。固定時間取樣在移動系統中對應空間間隔，速度越高相同頻率越容易漏過狹窄特徵。時間戳抖動會讓空間取樣不均勻；提高取樣率仍需足夠感測頻寬與抗混疊處理，不能只增加資料列數。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：等速與等時間取樣的間距，不代表可以解析同樣大小的最小缺陷。~Convert fixed-time samples into distance spacing and identify events that may be missed when passing a short landmark at high speed. Time sampling in a moving system corresponds to spatial spacing; at higher speed, the same rate can miss narrow features. Timestamp jitter makes spatial samples nonuniform. A higher rate still requires adequate sensor bandwidth and anti-alias filtering, rather than merely more rows of data. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Spacing for constant speed and uniform sampling; it is not automatically the smallest resolvable defect size.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：移動速度 v=25 m/s；取樣頻率 f=20 Hz。公式 y=v/f，代入得 y=1.25 m/sample。邊界：等速與等時間取樣的間距，不代表可以解析同樣大小的最小缺陷。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: motion speed v=25 m/s; sampling frequency f=20 Hz. Formula y=v/f gives y=1.25 m/sample. Boundary: Spacing for constant speed and uniform sampling; it is not automatically the smallest resolvable defect size.
units.verify: 對已知長度特徵以不同速度重播，檢查事件是否保留並比較位置內插誤差。以「速度取樣與空間間距」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Replay a known-length feature at different speeds, check event retention, and compare position-interpolation error. For speed sampling and spatial intervals, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 高頻振動混疊成低頻漂移可能被誤判為幾何偏差，遺失時間戳也會破壞空間重建。回到「速度取樣與空間間距」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~High-frequency vibration can alias into apparent low-frequency geometry drift; missing timestamps also corrupt spatial reconstruction. Trace the input chain for speed sampling and spatial intervals. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 取樣頻率固定時不同速度的空間解析度也一定相同~Fixed sampling frequency gives identical spatial resolution at every speed.
units.practice: 只把移動速度 v 從 25 改成 27.5 m/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1.25 變為 1.375 m/sample。先說明「速度取樣與空間間距」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only motion speed v from 25 to 27.5 m/s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 1.25 to 1.375 m/sample. Explain the causal direction for speed sampling and spatial intervals, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 融合感測時基漂移~Clock drift in sensor fusion
units.title: 融合感測時基漂移~Clock drift in sensor fusion
units.mechanism: 本單元比較各感測器時鐘的頻率偏差，解釋為何一致的座標仍可能因不同時間而無法融合。時鐘頻率偏差會隨時間累積成時間差，校時瞬間的偏移與之不同。多系統事件排序若依不同時鐘，可能把因果順序顛倒；校時跳變又會使量測區間長度失真，所以需記錄時鐘品質與校正事件。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。~Compare frequency offsets of sensor clocks, explaining why consistent coordinates may still be incompatible when they describe different times. Clock frequency error accumulates into time offset and differs from initial synchronization offset. Ordering multisystem events on different clocks can reverse apparent causality. Synchronization jumps can distort interval lengths, so clock quality and correction events must be recorded. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：時鐘頻率偏差 drift=20 ppm；未校時期間 duration=3600 s。公式 y=drift*1e-6*duration，代入得 y=0.072 s。邊界：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: clock frequency offset drift=20 ppm; unsynchronized interval duration=3600 s. Formula y=drift*1e-6*duration gives y=0.072 s. Boundary: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted.
units.verify: 用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。以「融合感測時基漂移」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Compare offsets at several times against an independent reference, using slope to distinguish frequency error from a one-time jump. For clock drift in sensor fusion, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 只對齊開始時刻卻忽略頻率漂移，會讓長測試中的事件逐漸錯位，並誤判通訊延遲。回到「融合感測時基漂移」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Aligning only the initial instant leaves frequency drift uncorrected, progressively misaligning events and suggesting false network delay. Trace the input chain for clock drift in sensor fusion. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致~Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day.
units.practice: 只把未校時期間 duration 從 3600 改成 3960 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.072 變為 0.0792 s。先說明「融合感測時基漂移」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only unsynchronized interval duration from 3600 to 3960 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.072 to 0.0792 s. Explain the causal direction for clock drift in sensor fusion, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 區段占用作粗定位~Section occupancy as coarse location
units.title: 區段占用作粗定位~Section occupancy as coarse location
units.mechanism: 本單元把計軸區段占用當作粗範圍約束，明確指出它不能直接提供連續車頭位置。計軸占用利用邊界流入與流出守恆，計數差不是列車位置量測。差值為零仍需邊界感測器、方向判斷與狀態可信度成立；未知或故障狀態不能僅因兩個數字相等就自動宣告清空。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：離線整數守恆模型，不含任何現場重置或解鎖程序。~Use axle-count section occupancy as a coarse range constraint, explicitly showing why it cannot directly provide continuous train-front position. Axle counting applies conservation at section boundaries; the count difference is not a position measurement. A zero difference is useful only when boundary sensing, direction and state validity are trustworthy. Unknown or failed states cannot be declared clear merely because two numbers match. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Offline integer-conservation model without any real reset or release procedure.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：進入軸數 enter=48 axles；離開軸數 leave=44 axles。公式 y=enter-leave，代入得 y=4 axles。邊界：離線整數守恆模型，不含任何現場重置或解鎖程序。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: entering axles enter=48 axles; leaving axles leave=44 axles. Formula y=enter-leave gives y=4 axles. Boundary: Offline integer-conservation model without any real reset or release procedure.
units.verify: 以標記輪對的玩具車雙向重播，對照人工真值、事件順序與感測器有效旗標。以「區段占用作粗定位」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Replay a marked model vehicle in both directions and compare manual truth, event ordering and sensor-validity flags. For section occupancy as coarse location, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 漏計與多計可能互相抵消形成假零值，方向錯誤則會讓計數增減的符號顛倒。回到「區段占用作粗定位」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Missed and extra counts can cancel into a false zero, while direction errors reverse the signs of increments. Trace the input chain for section occupancy as coarse location. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 進出計數剛好相同就能無條件證明區段無車~Equal entry and exit counts unconditionally prove that a section is empty.
units.practice: 只把進入軸數 enter 從 48 改成 49 axles（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 4 變為 5 axles。先說明「區段占用作粗定位」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only entering axles enter from 48 to 49 axles (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 4 to 5 axles. Explain the causal direction for section occupancy as coarse location, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 定位處理管線~Localization processing pipeline
units.title: 定位處理管線~Localization processing pipeline
units.mechanism: 本單元追蹤感測、濾波、地圖比對與輸出更新的時間，防止漂亮的定位誤差掩蓋過時結果。端到端延遲由量測、通訊、運算與致動串接而成。改善最快的一段通常影響有限，且平均延遲不能代表最壞尾端；定義一致的起訖事件，才能避免子系統都量到好看的數值卻漏掉交接等待。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。~Trace sensing, filtering, map matching and output-update timing so an attractive position-error statistic cannot conceal stale results. End-to-end delay spans sensing, communication, computation and actuation. Improving the fastest stage often yields little benefit, and mean latency does not represent its worst tail. Consistent start and end events prevent subsystems from reporting attractive numbers while overlooking handoff queues. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：量測時間 sense=0.03 s；網路時間 network=0.08 s；運算時間 compute=0.02 s；致動時間 actuate=0.12 s。公式 y=sense+network+compute+actuate，代入得 y=0.25 s。邊界：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensing time sense=0.03 s; network time network=0.08 s; computation time compute=0.02 s; actuation time actuate=0.12 s. Formula y=sense+network+compute+actuate gives y=0.25 s. Boundary: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails.
units.verify: 沿同一事件編號串接時間戳，檢查每一段邊界是否重疊或漏算，並注入負載重測。以「定位處理管線」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Follow one event identifier through timestamps, check stage boundaries for overlap or gaps, and repeat under injected load. For localization processing pipeline, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 時間基準不同可造成負延遲假象；漏記排隊會使快速單元測試無法預測整合表現。回到「定位處理管線」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Different clock references can create apparently negative delays; omitted queues prevent fast unit tests from predicting integrated performance. Trace the input chain for localization processing pipeline. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短~Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay.
units.practice: 只把網路時間 network 從 0.08 改成 0.088 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.25 變為 0.258 s。先說明「定位處理管線」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only network time network from 0.08 to 0.088 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.25 to 0.258 s. Explain the causal direction for localization processing pipeline, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 失訊與錯圖案例~Signal-loss and map-error cases
units.title: 失訊與錯圖案例~Signal-loss and map-error cases
units.mechanism: 本單元建立隧道失訊、地圖偏移與輪滑的離線案例，要求融合結果能顯示不確定度而非假精準。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。~Build offline cases for signal loss, map offset and wheel slip, requiring uncertainty to remain visible rather than reporting false precision. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。公式 y=tested/total，代入得 y=0.8 1。邊界：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
units.verify: 建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。以「失訊與錯圖案例」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence. For signal-loss and map-error cases, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。回到「失訊與錯圖案例」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Trace the input chain for signal-loss and map-error cases. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險~One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
units.practice: 只把已執行案例 tested 從 72 改成 73 cases（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.8 變為 0.811111 1。先說明「失訊與錯圖案例」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only executed cases tested from 72 to 73 cases (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.8 to 0.811111 1. Explain the causal direction for signal-loss and map-error cases, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

facts: 教學假設：輪徑比例與里程採 distance=1500 m；本課公式結果 6.2 m，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for wheel-scale error and odometry: distance=1500 m; this model gives 6.2 m, not a field rating.
教學假設：局部通過速度觀測採 spacing=0.3 m；本課公式結果 20 m/s，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for local passage-speed observations: spacing=0.3 m; this model gives 20 m/s, not a field rating.
教學假設：獨立觀測加權融合採 x1=100 m；本課公式結果 100.8 m，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for weighted fusion of independent observations: x1=100 m; this model gives 100.8 m, not a field rating.
教學假設：定位不確定度合成採 s1=3 mm；本課公式結果 5 mm，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for combining localization uncertainty: s1=3 mm; this model gives 5 mm, not a field rating.
教學假設：延遲定位外推採 v=18 m/s；本課公式結果 5.1 m，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for extrapolating delayed positions: v=18 m/s; this model gives 5.1 m, not a field rating.
教學假設：速度取樣與空間間距採 v=25 m/s；本課公式結果 1.25 m/sample，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for speed sampling and spatial intervals: v=25 m/s; this model gives 1.25 m/sample, not a field rating.

sources.scope: 支持二零二三年列控技術規則發布與範圍；不把簡化模型當成正式制動曲線。
sources.scopeEn: Supports publication and scope of the twenty-twenty-three control regulation; simplified models are not operational braking curves.

sources.title: 鐵路可靠度安全方法分冊
sources.scope: 支持方法分冊的出版年代與範圍；不複製條文或宣稱教材為合規論證。
sources.scopeEn: Supports edition year and scope; clauses are not reproduced and the lessons do not establish compliance.

sources.title: 瑞士列車防護系統背景
sources.scope: 支持聖哥達代表工程與列控背景；課程數值均非該隧道設定。
sources.scopeEn: Supports Gotthard as a reference and train-control context; course values are not tunnel settings.

sources.title: 伊莉莎白線官方工程背景
sources.scope: 支持代表性鐵路路線名稱與官方營運來源，未聲稱其使用本課假想配置。
sources.scopeEn: Supports the reference route and official operator, without claiming use of the hypothetical lesson arrangement.
